related.title: Apache Avro：writer/reader schema 相容演進
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：同時用投影欄位與 min/max 篩掉不需要的 row group，計算可讀取的資料量。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use projection and min/max predicates to prune columns and row groups and compute candidate bytes. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 讓新 reader 讀舊事件，檢查新增欄位 default 與移除欄位的解析行為。
related.differenceEn: Read old events with a new reader and inspect defaults and omitted fields.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Parquet 以 row group 中各 column chunk 組織；統計可排除確定不匹配群，但候選仍須檢查。 教學基準：4*5*10 = 200 unpruned MiB；第二檢核：1*2*10 = 20 candidate MiB after two prunings。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
Avro 解析同時使用 writer 與 reader schema；新增欄位是否可讀取取決於 reader default 等規則。 教學基準：100 = 100 default-populated records；第二檢核：2+1 = 3 reader fields。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Parquet organizes column chunks within row groups; statistics can exclude impossible groups while candidates still require filtering. Teaching baseline: 4*5*10 = 200 unpruned MiB; second check: 1*2*10 = 20 candidate MiB after two prunings. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

Avro resolution uses both writer and reader schemas; new fields depend on reader defaults and resolution rules. Teaching baseline: 100 = 100 default-populated records; second check: 2+1 = 3 reader fields. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 建立repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,230px),1fr))，量測1000、520、320 px下的欄數與卡寬。
related.differenceEn: Build repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%,230 px),1 fr)) and measure columns and widths at 1000,520,320 px.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。

固定最小卡寬與gap決定可容納欄數；auto-fit與minmax讓剩餘空間分配給已存在的軌道。
教學基準：floor((1000+24)/(230+24)) = 4 columns_or_px；對照：(520-24)/2 = 248 columns_or_px。
